ballots.summary: Round-1 re-ballot after visibility was resolved via the exact file index: I read all 17 listed files (bounded pages for the large JSON contracts) and can now score on evidence, superseding my round-0 abstention which was purely an artifact-readability failure. The artifact is a coherent, internally consistent architecture and execution contract for converging the legacy command/knowledge flows onto the frozen Comet single-controller profile, and it matches the gated decision exactly: implementation authorization only, with runtime acceptance, business-profile enablement, and all external writes/publication still gated. Independently verified: task-dag.json has 39 nodes / 69 work packages, all depends_on edges point backward within the 39 single-node waves, and VERIFY is the sole sink depending on all 38 other nodes; counts 92 original + 12 new = 104 scenarios and 108 retained + 10 repair + 12 new = 130 required checks are consistent across SOURCE-MANIFEST, replan record, handoff, contract, and commands_status; the acceptance_aggregation maps all 104 scenarios (A01-N12) to concrete check IDs; spec.md N01-N12 oracles textually match the V_N01-V_N12 expected fields; bindings.json covers N01-N12. Boundary design is strong and frozen: Comet sole Run/state/dispatch/recovery owner with no second currentPhase, TeamAI distribute-only, pure-evaluate Gate, execute-only Runner/adapter, method skills without dispatch authority, Kp blocking all archive entries and Kt blocking completion, monitor/supervisor outside business authority (drift-lock frozen interfaces lines 115-155, global constraints 157-167, controller_override/closeout_override lines 4072-4073). Security posture for this stage is sound: trusted identity from launcher records not role strings (V_RW_TRUSTED_REVIEW, observer_contract pass_requirements), real OS/container role isolation as a negative gate (V_RW_RUNNER_BUILD, RoleBoundary.v1), secrets only as purpose-bound SecretRef.v1, fail-closed disclosure-intersection publication authorization with unknown≠public (U02/U06, V_U04-U06), quarantine/fence-on-restore (Restore.v1), R10 sole-workspace retention, no production/remote writes without registered grants, credentials_included=false. Fail-closed reliability semantics (UNVERIFIED nonzero, no skip-to-PASS, historical_results_may_close=false everywhere, monotonic invalidation with no byte-restore revival) are consistently expressed. Two non-blocking drift risks remain and are owned by existing DAG tasks: the managed-pilot vs comet-managed-v2 profile token split (R2-001) and the stale pre-convergence IMPLEMENTED/PASS journey_definitions labels (R2-002), both explicitly flagged as planned-not-executed interfaces by the governing contract. I would authorize implementing the frozen converged profile under the recorded existing authorization with the artifact's own verification gates left intact.

APPROVE for implementation scope only. With the coordinator's exact file index I re-read the unchanged artifact (SHA 9784847e...) and independently re-verified it end to end this round: all 15 manifest per-file hashes and 9 in-staged replan hashes match actual bytes; drift-lock's four internal sha256 pins match; the DAG has 39 nodes / 69 unique work packages, is acyclic, has zero dangling references, a single VERIFY sink, and waves that cover every node exactly once in valid topological order with all nodes CURRENT_PROFILE_NOT_VERIFIED; the execution contract has 130 unique checks, all required, all historical_results_may_close=false, all in planned-not-executed states, with every task_ids/implementedBy reference resolving to a real DAG node; scenario coverage is exact and mutually consistent (104 DAG acceptance IDs = 104 spec.md scenarios incl. N01–N12 = 104 case-plan cases all CURRENT_PROFILE_RETEST_REQUIRED with historical_pass_inherits=false = 104 bindings keys = 104-entry aggregation map verified check-for-check). The single-controller boundaries in ADR-0020 and the convergence architecture (no second currentPhase, pure Gate, dispatch-only TeamAI, Runner without business state, Kp blocks archive / Kt blocks completion, fencing on restore, R10 retention, purpose-bound secret references, disclosure-intersection publication, separately gated F10 cross-machine scope) are enforced identically in drift-lock frozen interfaces and the N01–N12 WHEN/THEN oracles. This matches the gated decision exactly: it authorizes implementing the frozen converged profile under existing authorization while runtime acceptance, business-profile enablement, and all external writes/publication stay gated behind the artifact's own VERIFY. The two MINOR findings re-confirmed open (R1-Z1 profile-token split across 95/12/12 commands plus a third token in flow_convergence; R1-Z2 stale pre-convergence IMPLEMENTED labels on three journey_definitions) are forward drift risks inside interfaces explicitly declared 'planned, not executable evidence', are barred from closing anything by historical_results_may_close=false and the all-130-current-PASS completion predicate, and are already owned by P3_1/P3_2 — not blockers. Round-0 visibility dissent (R1-001/CA-001) reflects a round-0 tooling limitation now resolved by the exact file index, not an architecture defect. I would authorize the gated decision now.
APPROVE，仅批准既有授权内实施。重新读取并独立核对后，单主控边界、原DAG、104场景与130检查映射，以及Kp阻断归档、Kt阻断完成、权限和恢复约束均支持该决策。两项命令与历史标签问题可在既有任务中修订，须于VERIFY前闭合；本票不证明运行或发布已通过。

findings.claim: 分段读取已消除此前的可见性问题；冻结契约足以支持本次实施决策，未发现阻断性的所有权或验收依赖循环。
findings.evidence: SOURCE-MANIFEST.json所列15个文件摘要全部匹配。openspec/changes/delivery-foundation-rearchitecture/task-dag.json#/tasks、#/waves包含39个唯一节点、69个唯一工作包，拓扑顺序有效且VERIFY为唯一汇点；tasks.md工作包表的身份、父任务依赖和AC与DAG一致。execution-contract.json#/acceptance_aggregation与全部130项required检查的场景引用一致，覆盖spec.md全部104场景。docs/architecture/comet-ai-devops-convergence.md:52–57、105–111明确单主控、可信身份及原Run恢复边界。

findings.claim: 验收命令的profile参数尚未统一，存在VERIFY检查落到不同配置基线的风险。
findings.evidence: openspec/changes/delivery-foundation-rearchitecture/execution-contract.json#/checks/0/command及#/checks/116/command使用managed-pilot，#/checks/118/command至#/checks/129/command使用comet-managed-v2；verification-case-plan.json的92条intended_command均使用managed-pilot。execution-contract.json#/commands_status明确这些命令仍须实现或资格化。

findings.claim: 三条旅程仍保留历史IMPLEMENTED/PASS标签，容易被误读为当前基线已有通过证据。
findings.evidence: openspec/changes/delivery-foundation-rearchitecture/verification-case-plan.json#/journey_definitions的三个条目均标为IMPLEMENTED，并记录2026-10-23、VERIFY @ 0dcfec1的PASS；但其顶层status为CURRENT_PROFILE_NOT_VERIFIED，execution-contract.json#/checks/114、#/checks/116、#/checks/117均为PLANNED_REPAIR_NOT_EXECUTED且historical_results_may_close=false。当前禁止继承规则阻止这些历史标签直接关闭检查。

findings.claim: Re-verified (F3 remains open): the verification-runner profile token is split across the current check set — V_N01–V_N12 use '--profile comet-managed-v2' while 95 other checks use '--profile managed-pilot', the case-plan's 92 original cases use '--profile managed-pilot' and its 12 N-cases carry no intended_command at all, and flow_convergence.profile_source_target names a third token 'foundation/profiles/comet-managed.json' with no alias/reconciliation rule anywhere in the contract.
findings.evidence: execution-contract.json checks: V_N01 command 'node tools/verify/delivery-journey.mjs --scenario N01 --profile comet-managed-v2 ...'; computed profile distribution across all 130 commands = {managed-pilot:95, comet-managed-v2:12, no-token:23 (non-journey regression/infra checks)}; verification-case-plan.json intended_command distribution = {managed-pilot:92, missing:12}; execution-contract.json flow_convergence.profile_source_target='foundation/profiles/comet-managed.json'; no contract section other than 'checks' mentions either token. commands_status declares these are planned public interfaces, not executable evidence, and completion_predicate requires all 130 checks current PASS at VERIFY, so a dead token would fail loudly rather than silently pass.

findings.claim: Re-verified (F4 remains open): verification-case-plan.json journey_definitions (same-run-delivery, real-comet-recovery, post-delivery-permissions) still carry status 'IMPLEMENTED' with execution text 'VERIFY @ 0dcfec1: recipe check PASS + 真实旅程执行 PASS' from the pre-convergence 2026-10-23 baseline, which post-reset could be misread as current passes; the governing contract correctly supersedes them.
findings.evidence: verification-case-plan.json journey_definitions entries vs execution-contract.json V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY / V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY / V_POST_DELIVERY_PERMISSIONS with implementation_status=PLANNED_REPAIR_NOT_EXECUTED and historical_results_may_close=false (verified false on all 130 checks); journey_execution.owner=VERIFY with order_semantics requiring the recovery fault window inside the same product Run; case-plan top-level status CURRENT_PROFILE_NOT_VERIFIED and all 104 cases CURRENT_PROFILE_RETEST_REQUIRED with historical_pass_inherits=false (verified on all 104).

findings.claim: Round-0 read-visibility dissent is resolved on my side: with the coordinator's exact file index the artifact is fully readable and byte-verifiable, so R1-001 (claude-code) and CA-001 (codex-agent) describe a tooling/index limitation of round 0, not a defect of the architecture, and no architecture blocker was found hiding behind the previously truncated reads.
findings.evidence: All 15 SOURCE-MANIFEST.json per-file SHA-256 hashes and all 9 in-staged convergence-replan-record.json hashes match actual bytes (computed this round); drift-lock.json internal plan/architecture/dag/execution_contract sha256 fields all match their targets; task-dag.json (1552 lines) and execution-contract.json (4664 lines) were parsed completely with no truncation via bounded structural reads.

findings.claim: The frozen converged profile is structurally sound and internally consistent across every machine contract, and it scopes itself to implementation-only authorization exactly as the gated decision requires.
findings.evidence: task-dag.json: 39 nodes / 69 unique work packages / 0 duplicate or dangling references / acyclic (DFS) / single sink VERIFY / waves cover all nodes exactly once in valid topological order / all 39 nodes CURRENT_PROFILE_NOT_VERIFIED. execution-contract.json: 130 checks, all unique, all required=true, all historical_results_may_close=false, all task_ids and implementedBy resolve to DAG nodes, all implementation_status values are planned-not-executed variants; acceptance_aggregation maps each of 104 scenarios to exactly the checks referencing it (exact-match verified for all 104); spec.md contains exactly 104 unique scenarios including N01–N12; bindings.json keys = the same 104 IDs. Boundary invariants match across ADR-0020, comet-ai-devops-convergence.md, architecture.md frozen interfaces, drift-lock.json frozen_interfaces and spec oracles: single Comet authority (no second currentPhase), Gate pure evaluate, Runner/adapter holds no business retry or DAG, Kp blocks all archive entries and Kt blocks completion, secrets only as purpose-bound SecretRef, restore quarantined with writer fencing, R10 workspace retention, F10 cross-machine stays separately gated.

findings.claim: One provenance pointer in convergence-replan-record.json (task-identity-map.json hash) cannot be verified because that file is not staged in the artifact; this is a historical pointer into replan-history, not a governance gap in the staged contract set.
findings.evidence: convergence-replan-record.json hashes lists task-identity-map.json=d617ea8d...; that path does not exist under the artifact directory and is not among the 15 SOURCE-MANIFEST.json files; drift-lock.json identity_map_sha256 is similarly a pointer to unstaged history. All other 9 replan hashes match staged bytes.

findings.claim: Verification-runner profile token is inconsistent within the frozen contract: the 12 new convergence checks V_N01-V_N12 use '--profile comet-managed-v2' while the original-scenario journey checks and the three full-journey checks use '--profile managed-pilot', and verification-case-plan.json intended_command strings are uniformly 'managed-pilot'.
findings.evidence: execution-contract.json V_N01 command (line 3749) 'node tools/verify/delivery-journey.mjs --scenario N01 --profile comet-managed-v2 ...' (same token in V_N04 line 3833, V_N05 3861, V_N12 4051); V_A01 command (line 154), V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY (line 3681), V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY (line 3613), V_POST_DELIVERY_PERMISSIONS (line 3722) all use '--profile managed-pilot'; verification-case-plan.json A01 intended_command (line 13) and the N-case entries (lines 2786-2995, which carry no intended_command) sit under case statuses CURRENT_PROFILE_RETEST_REQUIRED. commands_status (execution-contract.json line 4070) declares these are planned public interfaces, not executable evidence, limiting impact to drift risk at VERIFY time.

findings.claim: verification-case-plan.json journey_definitions still carry status 'IMPLEMENTED' with 2026-10-23 execution text claiming 'recipe check PASS + real journey execution PASS', which contradicts the governing execution contract's PLANNED_REPAIR_NOT_EXECUTED for the same three checks and could be misread post-reset as current passes.
findings.evidence: verification-case-plan.json lines 2998-3023: same-run-delivery/real-comet-recovery/post-delivery-permissions all status IMPLEMENTED, executed_at 2026-10-23T07:48:16Z, execution text 'VERIFY @ 0dcfec1: recipe check PASS + 真实旅程执行 PASS'; execution-contract.json V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY (3684-3698), V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY (3615-3632), V_POST_DELIVERY_PERMISSIONS (3724-3740) all implementation_status PLANNED_REPAIR_NOT_EXECUTED with historical_results_may_close=false and execution_owner VERIFY; file-level status CURRENT_PROFILE_NOT_VERIFIED (line 3) and convergence_revision 2026-10-24-comet-convergence (line 3024) supersede the stale labels.

findings.claim: Original-scenario checks define implementedBy but generally omit an explicit execution_owner field; final execution ownership is nonetheless unambiguous because the contract assigns the full 130-check re-execution to VERIFY.
findings.evidence: execution-contract.json V_A01-V_D08, V_C04-V_C08 samples (e.g., lines 171-174, 368-374) have implementedBy but no execution_owner, while V_N01 (line 3754), V_N04 (3838) and all three journey checks (3630, 3696, 3737) carry execution_owner: VERIFY; final_verification_task=VERIFY (line 3) and journey_execution.owner=VERIFY (line 4175) make final ownership singular.

findings.claim: Already-started execution (18 legacy entries moved to a recoverable backup, P1_2 anti-reintroduction repair in an isolated worktree) is correctly fenced as an authorized safety substep under prior retirement policy, not as profile acceptance, and destructive/global actions are explicitly out of scope.
findings.evidence: convergence-replan-record.json notes[1-2] ('Current-profile acceptance is0; actual18-entry retirement is a completed safety substep'; 'new business profile remains gated'); execution-contract.json flow_convergence.migration_safety_work (line 4662); runtime.capability_evidence explicitly states migration worktree isolation is not proof of product Runner security (lines 13-16); HANDOFF.md 当前安全子步 section (P1_2 limited to tools/adapters/claude-code.sh, test/foundation-distribution.test.js, report) and cleanup-scope bullets (不清空真实知识/数据库，不卸载全局/其它项目技能，不销毁旧Run或唯一工作区); ADR-0020 decision 1 requiring recoverable backups and excluding user-global assets.
